question_text: Explain how modelling entities, attributes, keys and relationships before implementing a database helps it support its intended use.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: The model identifies what must be stored and which records relate. Suitable keys uniquely identify records and connect tables; cardinalities prevent incorrect relationship assumptions. Reviewing the model can expose omissions or redundancy before they become implementation problems.
